The fix is complete. Here's what I changed in `textkit/slug.py`:

1. Added `text = re.sub(r"-+", "-", text)` to collapse consecutive hyphens into a single hyphen.
2. Added `text = text.strip("-")` to remove leading and trailing hyphens.

These two lines ensure that `slugify("Hello,  World!")` returns `"hello-world"` (instead of `"hello--world-"`) and `slugify("--a--b--")` returns `"a-b"` (instead of `"--a--b--"`). The public signature is unchanged.
